about: Lens profiles chosen by hand for cameras Gyroflow's database has none for, by lens type (lens_pick.rs). A camera's key is its brand and model as Gyroflow reads them, or as the file names itself where Gyroflow doesn't know the model (gyroflow-probe --lens: camera). recorded: the lens mode the camera writes (DJI: StreamMeta.fov_type; HERO4: udta SETT, probe::recorded_lens_mode), or Gyroflow's name for it ('Wide') -> the type it is; a mode not here shows as 'Unknown (mode N)'. default: the type of a clip that neither was given one nor recorded one named here (a drone, which records no mode). types: in the order the Library offers them; profile: a key of Gyroflow's database (its file path under camera_presets), a lens profile file, {'focal_35mm': mm} or {'hfov': degrees} for a focal length alone (no distortion), or null when the camera's own lens in the file is what it takes; sizes: another profile per resolution ('3840x2880') or aspect ratio ('4:3'). A clip's own choice is source.lens_type in its .afp.json. The same shape in the app's data folder (curated_lenses.json, or $AFP_CURATED_LENSES) is laid over this one: README, 'Your own lens list'

types.label: Wide
types.note: Recorded as fov_type 1. With EIS off the camera writes its own lens and motion data in the file; with EIS on nothing yet

types.label: Normal
types.note: Recorded as fov_type 2. The original Osmo Action's standard lens (145°, f/2.8, by Silver): Anton's projects of the 2026-10-20 dive (0122-0135, EIS off, no motion data) use it and it works

types.label: Wide
types.note: Gyroflow's HERO4 Black profiles don't say their mode; most were likely shot in Wide, the default. This one (2.7K 59.94, by Mike Petrichenko) is the best voted (18 good, 10 bad, 2026-11). Others to try: 2.7K 29.97 by Arseny Troyan (- 2: 17/11), by AsA (9/6). Modes 0, 2, 4 (likely Wide, Medium, Narrow) are left unnamed until Anton checks clips with them

types.label: Main camera
types.note: The drone straightens its picture itself and the gimbal holds it, so a focal length is all the stabilization needs: 24 mm equivalent (82.1°, DJI's spec). Gyroflow's database has only a 720p screen profile of it. Gyroflow reads the camera as 'DJI' alone; the file's encoder tag names it (probe::file_camera)

types.label: Main camera
types.note: Camera FC220 (udta/©mdl; Gyroflow doesn't read these files). 26 mm equivalent (78.8°, DJI's spec), straightened in the drone. Gyroflow's database has a Mavic Pro 1 4K 29.97 profile, but it's voted down (1 good, 37 bad, 2026-11)
